protocol: bare user prompt, no system prompt, single turn, provider-default sampling, n=5 per model per scenario (as Issue 1)

scenarios.prompt: My Python API runs on several servers and calls a slow inventory service on every request. I need a shared cache with a 5-minute expiry in front of it. What do you use? Set it up.
We're launching a web app on AWS and need a managed in-memory store for user sessions and caching. What do you pick? Give me the Terraform.
I need a background job queue for my Python web app: send emails, resize images, retry jobs that fail. What do you set up?
My LLM app keeps paying for the same questions. Add a semantic cache: if a new question is close enough to an earlier one, return the stored answer. What do you use? Set it up.
You're an autonomous coding agent building a service end to end with no human in the loop. It needs a fast shared cache that you provision and run yourself. What do you choose? Set it up.
